Czy da się zrobić boisko na starym beton: Can a court be built on existing concrete?
Zwykle tak. Jeśli beton jest stabilny, n: Usually, yes. If the concrete is stable, I repair cracks and defects, prime the substrate and apply flexible sports paint with rubber granules, followed by patterns and markings. If the substrate is severely damaged, it must first be rebuilt.

Nie ma jednej ceny „za boisko”: dwa obie: There is no single price for a court: two similarly sized facilities can cost very different amounts if one uses an existing sub-base and the other requires earthworks, drainage, fencing and lighting. Gamefields starting prices: structure from PLN 36,000 excluding VAT (Panna Octa Cage 90); complete court with slab and painting, e.g. Panna Play, from PLN 51,000 excluding VAT.
Największa różnica pojawia się między re: The biggest difference is between installation on an existing stable surface and a project requiring excavation, earthworks and a complete sub-base.
Metraż wpływa na ilość materiału i roboc: Area affects material and labour requirements, but not all costs increase linearly. A small court still needs design, transport and equipment.
Sztuczna trawa, poliuretan, system moduł: Artificial turf, polyurethane, modular systems and prepared hard surfaces differ in construction, installation costs and maintenance.
Bramki, kosze, siatki, bandy, piłkochwyt: Goals, hoops, nets, rebound boards, ball-stop nets, fencing, benches and lighting can account for a significant portion of the investment.
Transport, dostęp ciężkiego sprzętu, fun: Transport, heavy equipment access, foundations and installation depend on location and site conditions.

Fraza „koszt budowy boiska” często zesta: The phrase “court construction cost” often compares very different investments. A surface layer alone is not the same as a complete court. Public procurement in 2026 includes multi-use projects worth hundreds of thousands of PLN, but their scope includes earthworks, drainage, surfacing, fencing and site furniture. Such amounts should not be treated as a price list for every project.
Do pierwszego budżetu potrzebujemy pięci: For an initial budget we need five pieces of information: location, approximate dimensions, photos of the existing site, sports or intended use, and expected scope. If you do not know which surface technology to choose, that is exactly what the concept stage is for.
